rule: Opus or Fable only, never Sonnet (or Haiku). Fable for foundation work: schemas, asset types, data models, kernel/engines, cross-app GUI behaviour. Opus for the rest.

switches.rule: A build may switch to a lower model on its own (recorded, no approval). Switching to a higher model needs Brett's explicit approval: his own signed-in console click or an axHub approval (confirm, never a veto countdown). A session, agent, headless build or the orchestrator never approves an upgrade; a session that reaches one stops and asks.
